name: Internet Archive
summary: Search and item metadata for the Internet Archive's collections (texts, audio, video, software), plus Wayback Machine snapshot lookup and capture history, from its keyless public APIs.
notes: Keyless for every read here. Rate limiting answers 429, possibly with Retry-After.
Queries use the Lucene-like Advanced Search syntax: field:term, AND by default, ranges with [a TO b], e.g. publicdate:[2008-02-01 TO 2008-03-01] AND contributor:smithsonian.
An item is addressed by its identifier; metadata.get lists its files.
Wayback timestamps are yyyyMMddhhmmss, 1 to 14 digits (20060101 is fine).

endpoints.name: Search items
endpoints.summary: Items matching a query, with chosen metadata fields, paged by number.

fl.description: Metadata fields to return, e.g. identifier, title, downloads.

sort.description: Sort, field and direction, e.g. 'downloads desc'.

output.description: json for a JSON answer (the page also offers XML, CSV and RSS).

notes: Sorted paged results stop at the 10,000th; for more use search.scrape.
Send output=json; the docs' example does.

endpoints.name: Scrape all matching items
endpoints.summary: Every item matching a query, paged by cursor, for result sets beyond 10,000.

sorts.description: Fields to sort on, comma-separated; identifier, if given, must be last.

cursor.description: The cursor of the previous answer; omit to start.

total_only.description: true to return only the number of matches.

notes: Answers carry items, count, total and cursor; send cursor back until none is returned. With a cursor, total counts from the cursor on.

endpoints.name: Get an item's metadata and files
endpoints.summary: An item's full record: metadata (title, mediatype, collection...), its files with formats and sizes, and server locations.
notes: A missing item answers an empty array [], not an error.

endpoints.name: Get part of an item's metadata
endpoints.summary: One element of an item's record, e.g. metadata/title or files, optionally a slice of an array.

field.description: Path into the record, e.g. server, metadata or files/0.

start.description: For an array, the first index to return.

count.description: For an array, how many elements to return.

notes: The value comes wrapped as {"result": ...}; a missing path answers an error field.

endpoints.name: Find the closest Wayback snapshot of a URL
endpoints.summary: The archived capture of a URL closest to a time (latest when no time), with its Wayback link and status.

timestamp.description: yyyyMMddhhmmss, 1 to 14 digits; the most recent capture when unset.

endpoints.name: List Wayback captures of a URL
endpoints.summary: Every capture of a URL, prefix, host or domain in a time range, with timestamp, MIME type, status and digest.

url.description: URL to look up; a trailing /* means prefix, a leading *. means domain.

matchType.description: How url matches; exact by default.

output.description: json for a JSON array whose first row is the header; plain space-separated text when unset.

collapse.description: field or field:N; drops adjacent captures with the same value (first N characters).

limit.description: Most captures; -N for the last N (slow).

showResumeKey.description: true to print a resume key after the results when more exist.

resumeKey.description: Resume key of the previous answer, with the same other parameters.

notes: Set limit: a popular URL has a very large number of captures. Page with showResumeKey/resumeKey; offset scales poorly.
